purpose: Raw deduped workbook export generated from Google Drive Sanda workbooks.

importantTruth.dedupePolicy: Automatic merges are made only when identity is high-confidence: same DOB + gender + similar transliterated name, obvious same-event duplicate, or very strong name match with close DOB typo. Risky cases stay in duplicateReview.
importantTruth.resultsStatus: Fight-level results are extracted from the ცხრილი sheet for both events and joined to schedule/bracket data where possible.
importantTruth.bracketStatus: Brackets are generated by grouping divisions, participants, fights and results. The visual bracket tree/advancement layout from the old spreadsheet is preserved only partially as normalized fights, not as exact cell-layout geometry.
